A LITTLE INTEL BEFORE YOU CHARGE

GOT QUESTIONS,
CHIEF?

Every good strategy starts with good intel.
Here’s what we can share so far.

What exactly is Elevate 3.0?+

It’s the third edition of our annual event, featuring a hackathon and a business pitching competition. This year, the creative theme brings the clan spirit and playful world of Clash of Clans into the experience.

Which battle is right for me?+

Love turning ideas into working solutions? Head to the hackathon. Prefer shaping a business and making a compelling pitch? The business pitching competition is your arena. Full eligibility and participation rules will be shared before registration opens.

When and where does the battle begin?+

The dates, venue, and event format are being finalized. The confirmed details and full schedule will be announced here.

Do I need to play Clash of Clans?+

The theme sets the scene; the competitions are about building solutions and pitching business ideas. You can explore the event without any game knowledge. Final competition rules will be shared before registration.

Can I enter without a clan?+

Team sizes, solo participation, and team formation options will be confirmed in the competition guidelines. Those details are coming before registrations open.

How do I sign up?+

Registrations haven’t opened yet. The registration link, deadlines, eligibility, and any participation fees will be published here once confirmed.
